<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the described forward reaction (formation of ether oxygens, C‑C and C‑O bonds; breaking of a C‑O bond, aromatic hydroxyls and ketones). We’ll search the template catalog using these criteria on a plausible flavanone product SMILES (O=C1CC(O)C2=CC=CC=C2O1). The search should return templates with their mapped reactions and IDs, from which we can select the appropriate one.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1CC(O)C2=CC=CC=C2O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
